groups.title: Ships of exploration
groups.explanation: James Cook sailed in all four of these ships on his Pacific voyages.

groups.title: Dog breeds
groups.explanation: Each of these is a breed of dog kept in British homes.

groups.title: Small garden birds
groups.explanation: All four are small birds that feed in British gardens all year round.

sources.excerpt: This acclaim came at a pivotal moment in British overseas exploration, and it led to his commission in 1768 as commander of HMS Endeavour for the first of his three voyages.
HMS Endeavour was a Royal Navy research vessel that Lieutenant James Cook commanded to Tahiti, New Zealand and Australia on his first voyage of discovery from 1768 to 1771.

After Cook was killed in a skirmish following his attempted kidnapping of Hawaiian leader Kalaniʻōpuʻu, Clerke transferred to the expedition's flagship HMS Resolution and John Gore assumed command of Discovery.
HMS Adventure was a barque that the Royal Navy purchased in 1771.
The Beagle is a British breed of scent hound, similar in appearance to the much larger foxhound.
The Boxer is a medium to large, short-haired dog breed of mastiff-type, developed in Germany.
The Whippet is a British breed of sighthound.
The Rough Collie or Long-Haired Collie is a British breed of long-coated herding dog of medium to large size.
In Anglophone Europe, it is commonly known simply as the wren.

The European robin (Erithacus rubecula), known simply as the robin or robin redbreast in the British Isles, is a small insectivorous passerine bird belonging to the Old World flycatcher family Muscicapidae.
Dunnocks have also been introduced and become common in New Zealand.
Outside the breeding season, chaffinches form flocks in open countryside and forage for seeds on the ground.

editorNotes: Beagle is the tile that could go either way, since HMS Beagle carried Darwin and a beagle is a hound; the ships here are Cook's four, so Beagle belongs with the dogs. Swift and Swallow were left out of the birds because both have been ship names, which would have given the puzzle a second ambiguity. Boxer and whippet are dogs only, and wren, robin, dunnock and chaffinch are birds only.
